authorization: Continuation of the registered L13 throughput remediation after the fast row-boundary schedule failed engineering equivalence but remained a candidate scientifically calibrated approximation.

program_alignment.central_question: Can the full-charge intrinsic posterior be evaluated beyond L=11 without changing the registered physical record or sacrificing the accuracy needed for fixed-gap transition diagnostics?
program_alignment.scientific_layer: decoder-independent intrinsic recoverability; numerical-method validation only
program_alignment.epistemic_role: fresh exact-control falsification of a new approximation
upstream_dependencies: rejected engineering-equivalence test of the row-boundary schedule
program_alignment.information_value: The candidate already meets the frozen throughput cap. A fresh exact cohort can now decide whether its different truncation rule is scientifically accurate enough, without generating any L13 history.

question: On exact L9/L11 records that were never used in the prior boundary-MPS development or held-out sets, does row-boundary TT-SVD at chi 16 and 32 preserve sector posterior, gap, risk, fixed-gap classification and low-gap risk share within the accuracy required by the L13 contract?
smallest_intended_claim: Pass permits only replacement of the L13 posterior engine by the registered row-boundary approximation; fail closes this candidate at the frozen bond dimensions and budget.

competing_outcomes.validated: Every chi, sweep, cell and observable passes the exact-error gates on the fresh cohort, while the frozen throughput evidence remains within 7200 seconds.
competing_outcomes.accuracy_failure: Any exact-error, cutoff, risk-share, identity or sweep-specific gate fails; row-boundary truncation is rejected for L13 production.
competing_outcomes.censored: A source hash, replay, anti-leak, completeness, runtime or memory gate fails; no accuracy or L13 conclusion is promoted.

claim_boundary: This is a numerical-method validation. It cannot add an L13 point, estimate a threshold or crossing, identify a phase or exponent, relax the existing L13 sampling/sensitivity design, or reinterpret the completed L7-L11 scientific evidence.

research_basis.source_role: positive boundary-MPS contraction template only; it supplies no accuracy theorem for this ternary-current row-boundary adaptation
research_basis.literature_scope: No new physical or inferential model is introduced. The candidate is an implementation-specific approximation, so fresh paired exact validation—not an additional literature analogy—is the decisive evidence.

frozen_physical_and_observation_contract.observation: full physical charge record Q only
frozen_physical_and_observation_contract.hidden_information: physical current, activity/orientation uniforms and true logical sector are unavailable to the candidate evaluator
frozen_physical_and_observation_contract.independent_unit: one previously generated exact physical record

fresh_cohort.exclusion: Exclude all 96 record keys in boundary-mps-validation-cohort-2026-09-21.json, including both development and held-out splits, before stratification.
fresh_cohort.record_key_rule: Use stored record_key when present; otherwise use <source-file-stem>:index<sample_index>, exactly as in the prior cohort builder.
fresh_cohort.selection_rule: Within each L/q cell, sort all remaining records by (absolute exact signed gap, sample_index), divide the ordered indices into eight contiguous numpy.array_split strata, and in each stratum select the record minimizing SHA256('row-boundary-fresh-v1|' + record_key), breaking an impossible digest tie by record_key.

candidate_matrix.truncation_schedule: dense frontier updates within a completed lattice row; deterministic full-SVD TT truncation only at row boundaries
candidate_matrix.pairing: Every candidate is compared with the stored exact posterior for the same frozen physical record; chi and sweep branches remain paired within record.
candidate_matrix.no_development_split: The candidate implementation and gates are frozen. All 48 records are a single-use confirmatory cohort; no debugging or parameter selection may consume them.

validation_gates.source_and_replay: All six source hashes and the prior-cohort hash match; exactly 48 unique fresh record keys and charge hashes replay before candidate evaluation.
validation_gates.public_interface: Candidate receives only Q, p, q, public lattice geometry, chi, sweep direction and the frozen row schedule.
validation_gates.identity: Every sector mass is finite and nonnegative, normalization is positive, and risk equals 1/(1+exp(abs(DeltaF))) to 1e-10.
validation_gates.completeness: All 192 registered evaluations complete; missing or nonfinite rows censor the study.
validation_gates.per_cell_sweep_chi_gap: For every L/q/sweep/chi block of eight records, median absolute gap error <=0.02 and 95th-percentile absolute gap error <=0.05.
validation_gates.per_cell_sweep_chi_risk: For every block, 95th-percentile absolute record-risk error <=0.005.
validation_gates.fixed_gap_cdf: For a in {0.5,1,2,4}, every block has absolute exact-versus-candidate C_L(a) error <=0.02; with eight records this requires no cutoff misclassification.
validation_gates.low_gap_risk_share: For the same cutoffs, every block has absolute exact-versus-candidate B_L(a) error <=0.02.
validation_gates.throughput: The frozen remediation result must continue to project the unchanged L13 minimum primary+sensitivity matrix to <=7200 four-worker seconds.
validation_gates.all_branches: Both chi values and both sweep directions must independently pass every cell; agreement between approximate branches cannot substitute for exact accuracy.

uncertainty_and_analysis.reason: This is a finite paired method-validation cohort with deterministic per-record and aggregate error gates, not a population estimate.
uncertainty_and_analysis.promotion_rule: Promote only if every registered gate passes without parameter changes. Report the worst block for every metric, not only pooled averages.
uncertainty_and_analysis.failure_rule: Any failed branch rejects row-boundary TT-SVD at chi 16/32 for the L13 contract; do not select a favorable sweep, raise chi, relax a cutoff or reuse the cohort for tuning.

acceptance_criteria: The fresh cohort is frozen from the six immutable exact sources after excluding every prior selected record, before any candidate evaluation.
All 192 charge-only paired evaluations complete within the registered runtime and memory caps and pass identity, replay and anti-leak gates.
Every chi/sweep/L/q block passes the exact gap, risk, fixed-gap CDF and low-gap risk-share gates.
A pass changes only the numerical method named by the existing L13 contract; a failure keeps L13 production unarmed, and neither outcome supplies L13 scientific evidence.
stop_rule: This registration tick creates no cohort file, candidate evaluation, bootstrap replicate or L13 history. On the next authorized tick, freeze the cohort first and then run exactly this 192-evaluation matrix. Stop on any provenance or replay mismatch. After completion, either promote the candidate exactly as registered or reject it; do not tune on the fresh cohort.
decision: Promote row-boundary TT-SVD as a distinct validated approximation; repeat the frozen zero-history L13 preflight with row schedule before production.
